_comment: The group captures `page.js` and `lib-page.js` but not `style.js`, which only `page.js` loads and so stays in the chunk of `page.js`. Moving `page.js` and `lib-page.js` into a `lib` chunk would make that chunk import the chunk of `page.js` for `style.js`, and the chunk of `page.js` import the `lib` chunk for the page's exports, so the modules only `page.js` loads stay out of the group. `lib-shared.js` goes to a `lib` chunk, which Rolldown's chunk optimizer then joins with the page's chunk.
